changes: milestone_status now renders DONE stories from the frozen milestone-closeout snapshot when present, preserving live projection for active stories and missing-closeout fail-closed fallback; docs explain the active versus DONE behavior.
usage: Run node packages/main/dist/cli.js milestone_status --storyId=<DONE-story> or lattice milestone_status --storyId=<DONE-story> to view Completed, Current, and Remaining milestone tables.
expectedOutcome: For a DONE story with a valid milestone-closeout.json, Milestone Status shows completed closeout rows as ✅ Done, with no stale evidence or false blocked rows after active-story cleanup.
actualTranscript: Live smoke captured node packages/main/dist/cli.js milestone_status --storyId=B-e62e: Phase DONE, M1 and M2 under Completed as ✅ Done, Current none, Remaining none, Risks none.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible difference from the expected outcome; the captured transcript matches the expected DONE closeout-backed table behavior.
limitations: none - fully covered for this story scope; milestone_completion_set and completion ledger writer are intentionally not implemented here.
pitfalls: The global lattice wrapper killed long silent validation twice at 300 seconds; using node packages/main/dist/cli.js validate completed successfully and wrote fresh test evidence.
